athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

folder_id.description: Public folder or plan ID from search_workout_library, supplied as a positive 32-bit integer string. The selected athlete receives the shared folder; the public owner's athlete ID is not a target selector.

include_full.description: Include the verified folder description and blurb. Owner details, share tokens and child workout payloads are always omitted; this affects output detail only.
